text:
Ravi (AE): Quick escalation — PeregrineLabs CISO is holding the POC. Two non-negotiables: 1) BYO-KMS with attestation, 2) an on-prem connector with IP allowlist for their test harness. They want a firm start date next Tue. Can we commit? @Jae (Solutions) @Tom (Eng-Infra) :warning:
Jae (Solutions): Assuming BYO-KMS only, we can do a Private deployment in ~12 business days for full attestation. Short path: Dedicated + temporary managed KMS + extra logging to prove controls — that could get us into a demo in 4-5 business days but won't satisfy BYO-KMS requirement long-term.
Tom (Eng-Infra): On-prem connector requires packaging (containerized agent) + secure auth + tunnel. Rough ETA: 9-12 business days to ship a hardened connector and run internal pen-test. BYO-KMS adds 2-3 days for key rotation workflows and HSM handshake testing.
Nora (CS): Customer pushed for a named latency/throughput target for the demo (200ms p50 for small chat, 500ms p95) and clear fallback rules if we hit throttling. They also want a short cost summary for dedicated vs private for a 30-day pilot.
Priya (Legal): FYI I started drafting BYO-KMS contract language and a one-page attestation addendum. I'll circulate to Marta and SOC2 reviewer. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow. Also need mapping for their security questionnaire (we should return answers + evidence links).
deploy-bot: ci/build #4389 passed  deploy window clear. No infra impact expected.
ops-bot: Note: network egress peering request will need ops approval and ASN details from customer. Ops lead assigned: Carlos.
Jae (Solutions): Draft proposed options to present at exec sync:
1) Fast demo (4-5bd): Dedicated + temporary managed KMS, IP allowlist, audit logs. Pros: fastest; Cons: not BYO-KMS.
2) Gold (12-15bd): Private + BYO-KMS, on-prem connector, full attestation. Pros: meets CISO requirements; Cons: longer lead time.
3) Hybrid phased approach: quick demo on Dedicated w/ managed KMS, parallel delivery of BYO-KMS path and connector; swap mid-pilot once attestation complete.
Tom (Eng-Infra): Technical note — fallback model options: run int8 quantized variant for lower GPU memory and stable p95 latency. Example config snippet for runbook:
```
--model=redwood-compat/v1-int8
--batch-size=8
--max-latency-ms=500
```
Ravi (AE): Action items I hear: 1) Jae to prepare exec one-pager with cost delta + fallback SLAs (due before sync), 2) Tom to confirm connector ETA and list of infra changes (by 3pm PT), 3) Priya to finish BYO-KMS clause draft (EOD tomorrow), 4) Nora to get Peregrine's ASN/IPs and SOC questionnaire.
Jae (Solutions): Scheduling a 25-min exec sync at 3:30pm PT today. Invite sent to Eng and Legal. Please mark urgent. :calendar:
Tom (Eng-Infra): I'll run a quick feasibility run this afternoon and post notes here by 2:45pm PT. If we can accept a temporary managed-KMS concession and promise a hard swap-over date, we can hit their pilot window.
Priya (Legal): I'll add the questionnaire mapping as an annex to the draft and include evidence links (SOC2 cert, pen-test summary).
Nora (CS): I'll chase Peregrine for ASN/IPs and their exact acceptance criteria for attestation.
Ravi (AE): Great. After the sync I'll paste meeting notes here so Sales + Eng have a single source of truth. Keep updates in-thread only. :lock:
